config.mysti.defaultProvider.description: Primary AI provider for coding assistance. Switch providers anytime without losing context.
config.mysti.defaultProvider.enumDescrip: Claude Code CLI (Anthropic) - Deep reasoning, complex refactoring, thorough analysis
OpenAI Codex CLI - Quick iterations, familiar GPT style, rapid prototyping
Google Gemini CLI - Fast responses, Google ecosystem integration
Cline - Autonomous coding agent with browser use, file editing, and command execution
GitHub Copilot CLI - GitHub-native AI assistant with seamless GitHub integration
Cursor - AI-powered coding with fast editing and multi-file changes
OpenClaw - Open-source personal AI assistant with multi-model support and Gateway streaming
OpenCode - Multi-provider AI coding agent with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, and OpenRouter
Ollama - Local LLM inference server supporting Llama, CodeLlama, Mistral, and more
LocalAI - Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible local inference with GPU/CPU support
Qwen Code - Alibaba's AI coding agent with Qwen3-Coder models and multi-provider support

config.mysti.ollamaKeepAlive.description: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded in memory after the last request (e.g., '5m', '1h', '0' to unload immediately).

walkthrough.mysti.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with Mysti
walkthrough.mysti.gettingStarted.descrip: Set up Mysti step by step: provider, authentication, permissions, context, and multi-agent mode.
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.openChat.d:
Open Mysti from the Activity Bar or with ``Cmd+Shift+M`` (``Ctrl+Shift+M`` on Windows/Linux).

[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.setupProvi:
Pick the AI provider Mysti should use by default. You can change it later without changing any command or setting IDs.

[Choose provider](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mysti.defaultProvider%22%5D)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.installCli:
Mysti talks to provider CLIs installed on your machine. Install at least one supported CLI. The setup wizard can detect it and, where supported, help with installation.

[Open Mysti setup](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.authentica:
Sign in to the selected provider in its CLI. If Mysti reports an authentication problem, use **Run Diagnostics** in the setup wizard and follow the suggested command.

[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.permission:
Choose **Read Only**, **Ask Permission**, or **Full Access**. New users should start with **Ask Permission**; it keeps file changes under your control.

[Open access settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mysti.accessLevel%22%5D)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.firstMessa:
Ask Mysti to explain the current file, fix a bug, refactor a function, or write tests. Open files and selections can be included automatically when Auto Context is enabled.

[Open Chat](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.context.de:
Use **Add to Context** from the editor or Explorer when a task depends on a specific file or selection. This makes the request more predictable and easier to review.

[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.brainstorm:
Configure at least two providers, then enable Brainstorm to let two agents independently analyze, challenge, and synthesize a solution.

[Open Brainstorm settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mysti.brainstorm.enabled%22%5D)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.troublesho:
Open the Mysti setup wizard and run diagnostics. Check that the selected CLI is installed, available in ``PATH``, authenticated, and matches the path configured in Mysti settings.

[Open Mysti](command:mysti.openChat)
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.star.title: Star Mysti on GitHub
walkthrough.mysti.walkthrough.star.descr: If Mysti is useful, [star it on GitHub](https://github.com/DeepMyst/Mysti) and follow the project for updates.
